current_evidence: The council's 'What documents you need to submit' page (last updated 14 May 2026) links this PDF as 'Our Local List of Requirements For Planning Applications'. The PDF says it was re-adopted by Individual Executive Member Decision on 5 Sept 2025 (cover dated 8 Sept 2025), and its change log adds Technical Details Consent in April 2026.

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only', but the list has a Householder section with 13 local requirements: Arboricultural Assessment (trees protected by TPO in/adjacent to site); Bat Survey (suitable roosting area and works to roof incl. soffits/fascias, cladding, hanging tiles, weatherboarding, or demolition); CIL Additional Information Form (all); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (affects adjoining properties); Great Crested Newt Statement (red/amber risk zone and within 50 m of a known pond); Heritage Statement (within or including a designated heritage asset); Land Contamination Assessment (known/suspected contamination); Existing and proposed elevations (all); Existing and proposed floor plans (all); Parking provision plan (loss of parking or increase in habitable rooms); Site plan (all); Site Specific FRA (Flood Zones 2/3 incl. small extensions, critical drainage areas, etc.); Volume Calculations (Green Belt, or countryside where two-storey or new outbuilding).
issues.evidence: PDF Householder section, LOCAL VALIDATION REQUIREMENTS table

issues.detail: Full planning requirements Grokbot did not capture: Air Quality Assessment (in or adjacent to an AQMA); Arboricultural Assessment (impact on trees); AWE Impact Assessment (Burghfield AWE consultation zones); Badger Survey (badger sett consultation zone); Bat Survey; Biodiversity Net Gain information (major or minor); Biodiversity Report (major, or minor affecting protected species); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment; Delivery Management Plan (employment/retail with new or altered deliveries); Economic Viability Appraisal; Economic Statement (B1/B2/B8 over 1,000 m2 or loss of employment land); Electric Vehicle Charging Strategy (major); Floor Space Calculation (GEA change); Internal Floor Space Calculation (new dwellings); Foul Drainage Assessment (major); Great Crested Newt Statement (red/amber zone); Heritage Assessment (designated heritage asset); Infrastructure Delivery Plan (Strategic Development Location); Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment; Land Contamination (incl. greenfield sites); Noise Impact Assessment; Photographs (demolition, or impact on CA/listed building); Shop Front plans (new/altered shop fronts); Public Rights of Way Impact Assessment (PRoW in/adjacent to site); Stage 1 Road Safety Audit (major with highway alterations); Statement of Community Involvement (major); Sustainability Statement (new dwellings incl. replacements; non-residential over 100 m2); Transport Assessment (impact on strategic network); Travel Plan (major or strategic network impact); Volume Calculations (Green Belt/countryside).
issues.evidence: PDF Full Planning Approval section, LOCAL VALIDATION REQUIREMENTS table

issues.detail: Several triggers were copied from the change log or neighbouring table cells instead of the requirement. 'Ecological Survey' and 'Flood Risk Assessment' quote the change log ('Flood Risk Assessments - guidance expanded...'). 'CIL Additional Information / Form' quotes 'CIL was adopted in 2015 - wording no longer required' (change log); the actual trigger is 'All applications'. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' gives only 'Policy CC10'; the actual trigger is Surface Water Drainage Strategy for major or minor development. 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Parking provision' are run-on cells mixing parking, site plan and FRA text. 'Structural Survey' runs into the Affordable Housing description and quotes the works-to-trees subsidence note; the Full trigger is 'substantial demolition'.
issues.evidence: Change log row: 'Flood Risk Assessments - guidance expanded | To bring guidance in line with EA'

issues.detail: Thresholds are misstated or missing. 'Affordable Housing Statement' has no threshold; the source says net increase of 5+ dwellings, or a site over 0.16 ha with residential proposed. 'Retail / Town Centre Impact' quotes the loss-of-town-centre-use test; the source trigger is retail use outside town/village centres, or change of use within centres. 'Planning Statement' quotes the S73 wording ('to explain the reasoning for removing or varying condition'); the Full trigger is simply 'All applications'. 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' says 'major residential schemes'; the table says major development.
issues.evidence: PDF Full Planning Approval table: Affordable Housing Statement - 'Net increase of 5+ dwellings, or site over 0.16 ha'

issues.detail: The Listed building consent row 'Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) information' comes from the Variation/Removal of Condition (S73) section ('If your original application was not exempt from BNG any variation may affect this'). It bled into the LBC heading that follows in the PDF. The real LBC local requirements are not captured: Bat Survey (same trigger as Householder); Heritage Statement (all applications); existing and proposed elevations (all); floor plans (all); roof plans (roof works); site plan (all).
issues.evidence: PDF: '...updated BNG details may be required as a result. 21 LISTED BUILDING CONSENT DETAILS Typical description...'

issues.detail: Outline is marked '(none)', but the source requires documents as per Full Planning where relevant, plus: Biodiversity Net Gain information (all), Parameter Plans (all), and a Design and Access Statement or Sustainability Statement (residential over 10 dwellings incl. conversions; non-residential over 100 m2). The 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' row under Full and Reserved matters is actually the Outline/Reserved-matters intro text ('Access Plan - Where access is a reserved matter...'), not a highways visibility-splay requirement. Design and Access Statement is listed as a Full local requirement, but for Full applications it appears only among the national requirements.
issues.evidence: PDF Outline Planning Approval: 'Parameter Plans - All applications'

issues.detail: Other application types marked '(none)' that do have local requirements: Advertisement consent (elevations showing each advert with luminance/wattage, all; site plan, all; Planning Statement where the advert affects a listed building or is in a Conservation Area); S73 (CIL form if new floorspace; Planning Statement, all; site plan/elevations/floor plans if altered; location plan matching original red line; updated BNG); Lawful development certificates (proposed: elevations, floor plans, site plan, CIL form if over 100 m2; existing: site plan and evidence); Prior approval (CIL form for Class A, MA, AA and the new-storey classes; floor plans for Class AA); Non-material amendment (site plan; proposed elevations/floor plans as applicable); Discharge of conditions (information to discharge, all). The new Technical Details Consent type (April 2026) is missing entirely.
issues.evidence: PDF sections for Advertisement Consent, Variation/Removal of Condition, Lawful Development Certificates, Prior Approval, NMA, Discharge of Condition, Technical Details Consent

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is not a requirement: its trigger is a promotional sentence ('paid for pre-application advice service and we can tell you what will be needed'). The tab_item 'invalid applications ... resolved within 28 days' is process text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'paid for pre-application advice service and we can tell you what will be needed.'

issues.detail: The drawing-standards tab_items repeat the same scale-bar rule four times ('scale ... indicated either in writing or through the use of a scale bar', 'A scale bar is preferable...', 'If a scale bar is not included, the scale should be indicated in writing', 'The scale must be indicated in writing or through the use of a scale bar').

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wokingham local list, but the date comes from the upload folder (the list was re-adopted 5 Sept 2025, amended April 2026). The extraction is badly broken: Householder, Outline, Advertisement and other types wrongly show 'none', many Full requirements are missing, several triggers were copied from the change log, and the LBC BNG row actually belongs to the S73 section.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The List date of 2026-05-01 comes from the URL upload folder ('2026-05'). The document says it was re-adopted on 5 September 2025 (cover 8 September 2025, next review by 7 September 2027). The only later change is the April 2026 addition of Technical Details Consent. The council page's link tooltip still says 'Local Validation List Final - June 2019.pdf', which is misleading.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: PDF intro: re-adopted by Individual Executive Member Decision on '5th September 2025'; change log: 'Technical Details Consent application type and details added (April 2026)'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The upload-folder date basis is weak, but the list was amended in April 2026 (raw 908355558f change log: "Technical Details Consent application type and details added (April 2026)"). The current version is therefore April 2026, not September 2025, so 2026-05 is only one month off and the outdated flag is unaffected.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The April 2026 amendment makes 2026-05 close enough.
